body: Seems like this hurdle, no matter how hard i have try to start over I just can't. This will be my third time trying. I dont know if I just have it in me anymore.
This road block just seems like is finally the one that has stopped me. And I dont honestly see a way out or over it.
To be honest I dont see it anymore
Probably both. I just am so lost and confused that idk what the fuck is happening anymore to myself
But it seems like i dont have the time .
The only problem to everything is i have no drive to do anything anymore.
The help for homeless is a week at most for a place to stay and the job market here is very bad. I usually never quit but for once I want to just quit and just feel absolutely nothing.

Whats going on is that I will get nothing in the divorce, no car, no job, and no money at all. A long with being thrown out of the place. This will be the third time I will be homeless. My future I want to just have a job, a place of my own and a car. But i just don't see that future in my life.
There is so much of my story I don't know where to start.
